source: Davidsson et al. 2020, Bioorg. Med. Chem. Lett. 30:126953 (PII S0960894X20300068), Tables 1, 5, 6, 7, 8
targets: hGPR81 (HCAR1) EC50; hGPR109A (HCAR2) EC50; hGHS-R1a (GHSR) IC50
note: GPR109A agonism is the niacin-flush liability; GHS-R1a was the HTS cross-screen. Selectivity fold = GPR109A(or GHS-R1a) value / hGPR81 EC50.

1 (AZ1/CID57422810).comment: potent but NOT selective: GHS-R1a 0.008 uM = 3x more potent than GPR81; GPR109A only 5.3x

2.comment: better GPR109A selectivity but GHS-R1a still unselective

27.comment: pyrimidinone; text says >45-fold GPR109A, very weak GPR109A activity

28.comment: text: 41- and 82-fold, 'very interesting compound for further evaluation'

30.comment: MOST POTENT but GPR109A selectivity only 7.4x - the best compound is the least selective here

31.comment: pyrimidinone; text: 6-fold GPR109A selectivity, large variation vs 27 (>45x)

37.comment: trans-2,6-diMe morpholine; ~3-fold more potent than 35; no GPR109A/GHSR selectivity improvement

38.comment: cis-2,6-diMe morpholine; 10x more potent than 35; excellent 500-fold GHS-R1a selectivity; NO GPR109A improvement (~10x)

series_summary_from_text.constrained: pyridone 26/28 good (29-41x GPR109A, 62-82x GHSR); c30 best potency but worst GPR109A selectivity (7.4x); pyrimidinones 27 >45x GPR109A
series_summary_from_text.amides: GHS-R1a selectivity excellent (>70x, up to 500x for 38); GPR109A only ~10x (common SAR between GPR81 and GPR109A for amide linker)
series_summary_from_text.key: c28 = best overall balance (22 nM, LLE 5.3, 41x GPR109A, 82x GHSR). c38 = best GHS-R1a (500x) but GPR109A still ~10x. c30 = most potent (5 nM) but least selective (7.4x GPR109A).

relevance_to_docking_project.c30_vs_c31: pyrimidinone 27/31 improve GPR109A selectivity (>45x / 6x) but lose GPR81 potency - the GLU153 electrostatic penalty we computed for pyrimidinone N3 may trade potency for selectivity (HYP)
relevance_to_docking_project.region_selectivity_hypothesis: amides (orthosteric-pocket binders on 8Z8A) show >70x GHS-R1a selectivity while acyl ureas (TM5-TM6 binders) do not - binding-site difference may underlie GHS-R1a selectivity (HYP, untested)
relevance_to_docking_project.c30_caveat: the docking campaign's most potent compound has only 7.4x GPR109A selectivity - relevant for any lead nomination
